lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to add 1 to a score each time a gem is collected, and check the score at the end.
The score counts how well you are doing.
Each time you collect a gem, add 1 to the score.
Games say “You win!” when the score is big enough.
Collect 3 gems. After each one, add 1 to ⭐ score. End with score 3.
Score 3! One point for every gem.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
